title: review_submit input
description: Review one period of an engagement, once: the named one or your oldest open one. As the consumer, method derived submits the review derived from your assessed calls (derived-1). Hidden until the other party reviews or the window closes.

would_use_again.description: Whether you would use it again.

review_period_id.description: The period to review, from review.requested. Omitted: the oldest open period of this engagement you have not reviewed.

method.description: written (default), or derived: as the consumer, the review derived from the period's assessed calls. The network derives it itself with derived-1 and records the executions it rests on; the rating, criteria_met and would_use_again you send are replaced by its result.
